rate.notes: '0.6% לרבעון עם מינימום 40 ₪ לחודש', collection 'חודשי/רבעוני'. Section (4ב)2 prints a separate 'דמי משמרת' of 0.1% a quarter for managed accounts or accounts whose activity is holding assets rather than active trading. The tariff prints no exemption of makam or money-market funds from custody; the bank ban (BRK-17) does not apply to a non-bank member, and no rule limits its custody fee on them (BRK-52; BRK open question 11 closed 2026-10-26), so no excludes are recorded.
